title: Windows ISIS 9 native APP distribution
document_header: # Windows ISIS 9 Native APP Distribution Milestone

milestones.title: Design the native Windows ISIS APP release
milestones.completion_gate: An approved implementation-ready design fixes the Windows package format, explicit first-release APP inventory including reduce, jigsaw, and qnet, DLL/plugin/preferences/XML/data and launcher layout, clean-machine launch matrix, artifact/report names, hashes, and cleanup rules without placing standalone APPs in the PyISIS wheels.
